verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a genuine early-stage financing practice (VC practice page, TwoVenture 'Start & Seed' hub, German Term Sheet Generator for early financing rounds), but none of the evidence specifically mentions SAFEs or convertible instruments/notes. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE or convertible-note explainers/forms, dedicated pre-seed content, and independent corroboration of SAFE-specific expertise.
